sentences.text: Acutalibacter is a genus in the family Oscillospiraceae; the species Acutalibacter caecimuris and Acutalibacter intestini were described from anaerobic strains isolated from mouse caecal contents.
In a pilot study of 44 school-age children in the Lazio district of Italy, Acutalibacter was among the taxa associated with living near highly trafficked roads.
The authors of that study described Acutalibacter and Anaerotruncus as linked to chronic diseases for their pro-inflammatory activities.
